snippet.title: Desktop Waifu - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Congratulations!  After 20 long years, you've finally earned your very own Desktop Waifu. But she's missing something important — clothing!  Help her celebrate by making her clap through your clicks and typing skills. Each clap brings you closer to a new clothing piece or pet to collect for her. 

Steam release is coming soon and will be free to play! Integrated with the steam inventory so you can  buy your waifu whatever she wants! 

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702960/Desktop_Waifu/
Website: https://desktopwaifu.net
Discord: https://discord.gg/WWWEdJfEAM
